$comment: THE kit's identity. Declared here, projected into Python (lib/identity.py), bash (lib/project.sh) and PowerShell (lib/project.ps1). A declaration carries no behaviour, so no language owns it and all three read the same bytes. Renaming the kit is a change to THIS FILE. Every legacy* name is READ with one notice naming its replacement and never written; legacyRemovedIn is the release that stops reading them (ADR-001 decision 1).
